Individual Chocolate Cream Pie
By: nna mcneese
Published: Friday, May 27, 2011 - 11:47am

Ingredients




1 1/2 ounces (½ OF 3- ounce pkg)
cream cheese,softened
6 tablespoons sugar
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
2 1/2 tablespoons Hershey's Cocoa
2 1/2 tablespoons milk
1 cup chilled whipping cream
6 (4- ounce pkg) single serve graham crusts
Whipped topping
Hershey's Mini Chips Semi-Sweet Chocolate

Preparation

1 In small mixer bowl beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until well blended. Add cocoa alternately with milk,beating until smooth. 2 In separate bowl beat whipping cream until stift; fold into chocolate mixture. 3 Spoon into crusts. Cover; chill until set. Garnish with whipped topping and Mini Chips Chocolate

About


This recipe was one my mother gave me. It is fun to serve at parties or just have as a dessert to serve anytime...They are delish...
